description: This file defines the InterestsViewModel class for managing UI state related to interests in a Kotlin Android app, utilizing ViewModel, StateFlow, and dependency injection with Dagger/Hilt. It includes methods for following topics and handling topic selection, and manages UI states like loading and interests list.

classes.name: InterestsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages interests-related UI state, including follow/unfollow actions and topic selection. It observes followable topics and selected topic state, providing a combined UI state flow.

methods.name: followTopic
methods.description: Calls the repository to set whether a topic is followed or not.

methods.name: onTopicClick
methods.description: Updates saved state handle with selected topic ID, intended to handle topic click events.

methods.name: followTopic
methods.description: Facilitates following or unfollowing a topic by updating the repository.

methods.name: onTopicClick
methods.description: Handles a topic click by updating the saved state handle with the selected topic ID.
